description: Southern Provincial Council - Co-operative Employees Commission Statute, No. 05 of 2019
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the enactment of a new provincial statute (Statute of Co-operative Employees Commission No. 05 of 2019) that establishes a regulatory framework for cooperative employees in the Southern Province. It contains detailed legal provisions, disqualifications, appointment procedures, and operational guidelines, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
